name: Girls und Panzer der Panzussy
source:
You play as a new transfer student to Oarai Girls' Academy. However, you're not a normal girl per se, but a Futa.

The game takes place parallel to the original show with small changes but without massive retcons.

[Edited from [url=https://upforkilling.itch.io/girls-und-panzer-panzussy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名刚转入大洗女子学园的新转校生。只不过，严格来说你并不是普通的女生，而是一名扶他。

游戏剧情与原作动画主线平行展开，在保留整体框架不做大幅吃书改动的前提下融入了诸多微妙变化。

[摘自[url=https://upforkilling.itch.io/girls-und-panzer-panzussy]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
